notes: Evidence-ready delivery: choose Plan with proof for sample mutation data, meaningful assertions, stable API contracts and early runnable HTTP checkpoints. Weak persistence/empty-subset scenarios are rejected before approval; premature or deferred checkpoints receive task-batch feedback. New SQLite collection foundation supplies tested initialization, row mapping, IDs, filtering, daily counts, validation and restart behavior. Failed milestone repairs now retain approved task scope through static correction, and verifier exceptions cannot advance the cursor. Execution consent, frozen checks, saved projects and model settings remain intact; legacy plans are not silently migrated. Fixture-driven browser tests exercise real generated-app behavior and ZIP export, not live-model quality. For Tiny Wins use a fresh SQLite-foundation proof draft; keep the old project because its approved checks need explicit replacement review.
